# herdsman status

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Print a health snapshot of every agent in HERDSMAN_STATUS_SPECS and of the machine.

```text
usage: herdsman status
       herdsman status --route <route>

Prints a health snapshot of every agent in HERDSMAN_STATUS_SPECS
("name:pane:tree ...") and of the machine. LIMIT_MIN (30) flags a
background job running that many minutes or more.

With --route, prints one route's lifecycle state and its pair, flagging
a pair left pending, then each execution as the daemon's RuntimeService
reports it: identity, process, readiness, program status, visibility
(with the app open or closed), why it waits on a person, unresolved
items, notices by state, and the controls its backend allows, each on
its own line. <route> is a route name, a route folder, or @.

exit codes:
  0  the snapshot was printed
  2  usage error, HERDSMAN_STATUS_SPECS is not set, or an invalid
     LIMIT_MIN
```
